description: `m = Json.decode!("[\"fz\",\"x\"]"); Enum.count(m)` fails on interp and run with artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan: `Enumerable.count/1` has no implementation for the value it is called with. Same for a list extracted from a decoded map by pattern. The distiller is Enum over decoded JSON throughout. Prior analysis: fz-f98 memory notes real `any` is protocol ELEMENT erasure; fix at protocol dispatch. A dynamically typed receiver must dispatch at runtime on its actual type, on all three paths. Design question for the proposal page: where runtime dispatch lives and how it composes with typed specialization.
title: Enum and protocol dispatch work on runtime-typed values
